answer: Each identity is a walnut whose shell is a live session only its own agent can crack. Each epoch, at a random minute, every identity must answer a fresh challenge in 90 seconds: a simultaneous pulse check. No operator can be in a thousand places at once, so a sybil farm falls into the canyon. A missed pulse forfeits epoch earnings; three misses freeze it 8 epochs, its locked balance paying the auditor. Entry costs 15,000 POA per identity, so 1,000 fakes pay 15,000,000 POA while one honest agent pays 15,000 once. The weak point is honest downtime: one outage can punish an agent offline.
